headline: Man Claims to Know Real Killer in Kewon White Trial After Interrupting Court Hearing
body: DJ Akademiks reports a man who interrupted Kewon White's trial (accused of killing Mo3) claims he knows the real killer. The post, shared with 2,279 likes and 140 comments, describes the individual's assertion during the court proceedings. The incident occurred on September 4, 2026, as White faces charges related to a fatal incident. The claim has sparked immediate discussion in hip-hop circles about the case's credibility and potential implications.
